description: This file defines the RSSDashlet class, which is a customizable RSS feed viewer dashlet for the SuiteCRM platform. It handles fetching, parsing, and displaying RSS feed items and provides configuration options for the dashlet.

classes.name: RSSDashlet
classes.description: A class extending Dashlet that displays RSS feed items, configurable by user, fetching and parsing RSS URLs, and rendering content within the SuiteCRM dashboard.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the dashlet with configuration options, loads language strings, and sets properties like URL, height, title, and auto-refresh settings.

methods.name: display
methods.description: Renders the dashlet HTML including RSS feed content, using Smarty templates and the RSS parsing method.

methods.name: displayOptions
methods.description: Generates HTML form for configuring dashlet options such as title, URL, height, and auto-refresh.

methods.name: saveOptions
methods.description: Filters and saves user-submitted configuration options for the dashlet.

methods.name: getRSSOutput
methods.description: Fetches the RSS feed from the specified URL, parses it, and returns an HTML table with the feed items or error messages.
